notes: Real-upstream SWE-bench-style debugging task (scipy/scipy, trust-region minimize family). The bug: scipy/optimize/_trustregion.py builds the full local quadratic model -- calling fun, jac AND hess -- at the proposed trial point BEFORE deciding to accept the step, so an out-of-domain proposal aborts the whole run from inside the user's Hessian, and a NaN objective at the trial point is never treated as a rejection (stuck loop, success=False). Fix (upstream): evaluate the raw objective at the candidate first, map NaN to +inf so the step is rejected and the trust radius shrinks, and build the subproblem only after acceptance. Deliberately shaped per the v4.2 addendum: the instruction names the user-visible symptom and the API but not the issue (#26044), PR, fix commit, or the source file; the agent must author its own failing reproduction as a deliverable before fixing. Verifier runs the agent's reproduction against the pristine parent concept (single-file git restore of _trustregion.py; both directions enforced) and against the repaired tree, injects the upstream regression test extracted from the FIX commit at image build time (throwaway /tmp clone, removed; fix commit never enters /app/src/.git; also asserted `! git cat-file -e ${FIX_SHA}^{commit}` and removed the origin remote), runs the project's own test_trustregion.py suite, plus 4 authored hidden cases (reciprocal x+1/x with raising Hessian; NaN-only with a never-raising Hessian that proves the stuck-loop failure mode; the same loop shared by trust-ncg; and a scaled 3x-5*log(x) family at a different optimum), each verified to fail on the pristine tree and pass on the fixed tree. Final measurements: full final Dockerfile image build 4 min 42 s, image 2.0 GB (docker image inspect / docker system df unique), git HEAD pinned at a804efa6e with the fix commit unreachable in the shipped clone, full trustregion test file (9 tests) passes in ~0.6 s at 1 CPU, whole verifier ~25 s. Difficulty lands at hard (rubric total 18): the traceback points at the user's callbacks (misdirection), the root cause is a two-part evaluation-order/NaN-handling defect, and the agent must write its own reproduction from a prose symptom.
